supported: One explicitly selected tx3g track from a non-fragmented ISO-BMFF file; no auto-select when multiple tracks exist. Four bounded sample-table windows, local mdat reads, UTF-8 or BOM-tagged UTF-16, linear/leading-empty edits, deterministic escaped WebVTT.
limitations: No public/private browser route or UI track picker yet
No wvtt/stpp extraction, encryption, remote data refs, fragmentation, ctts or non-linear edits
No subtitle styling/colors, default/forced dispositions, positional modifiers, language embedding or remux back into media
Empty lines become visually blank nonbreaking-space lines; malformed or unrepresentable millisecond intervals reject

additionalChecks.tableWindowControl: 4,300 indexed samples, multiple table pages, last 1 ms cue exact.
additionalChecks.writeAndFailureControl: 65,535-character ampersand cue expands past multiple 64 KiB writes, one pending, cancellation after first write and injected quota failure propagate.
additionalChecks.initialTypeCheck: BigInt literal syntax failed the existing ES2017 TypeScript target; replaced with constructors/constants without changing target or timeline arithmetic.
